candidates.source_name: Ephrem the Syrian / Commentary on Exodus
candidates.source_attribution: Ephrem the Syrian, Commentary on Exodus XL.16 (NPNF S2 V13, Gwynn/Schaff trans., Oxford 1898). PD.
candidates.draft_body:
Ephrem the Syrian Commentary on Exodus (c. 360 AD)

When the tabernacle is finished, the cloud covers it and the glory of the Lord fills it. Ephrem reads the closing verse of Exodus as the canonical anticipation of the Apocalyptic vision: 'the tabernacle of God is with men, and he will dwell with them' (Rev 21:3). The whole book moves from the house of bondage to the house of glory. Tewahedo eschatological catechesis treats Ex 40:34 as the OT bookend of the canonical hope completed in Rev 21.
